name: Odyssey II Racing Helmet Envy
description: Continuing RSI's legacy of rugged and reliable helmets, the Odyssey II streamlines the original design into a lighter frame without sacrificing durability. This omni-purpose helmet was extensively field-tested in a variety of conditions and environments to keep you safe every time you suit up. This special Envy edition inspired by the Coramor festival features a vibrant pink and purple color scheme for the most enthusiastic of lovers.
